maya (Docs): Heads-up — I'm prepping the troubleshooting playbook for rate-throttle + timeouts, consolidating SDK snippets. Want to hand off for eng review today. ping @sam (Eng) @leo (SDK) :wave:

sam (Eng): thanks, what's scope? are we covering Retry-After + graceful fallback to smaller-context models?

maya (Docs): yes. Primary things: 1) how to interpret 429 vs connection timeout; 2) example code for exponential backoff using the Retry-After header; 3) migration snippet for old SDK (v0.9) -> new unified client; 4) recommended fallback policy: reroute to model 'redwood-medium' with trimmed context.

leo (SDK): I can do the migration snippets. Need exact API surface — is it `client.generate({ model, input, timeout })` or new `client.text.generate`?

maya (Docs): new unified: `await client.responses.create({model: 'gpt-redwood-xl', input})` (see top of doc). For backoff example use `Retry-After` header parse + jitter.

anita (PM): also include a note about token accounting — trimming context may change charges, call out cost implications and telemetry tag `fallback=rate-trim` so infra can measure.

sam (Eng): Tech notes: when we detect 429 with Retry-After, prefer to delay and retry; when we hit concurrency timeouts prefer to fallback immediately. Add sample logic:

```
if (resp.status === 429 && resp.headers['retry-after']) {
  await sleep(parseInt(resp.headers['retry-after']) * 1000 + randJitter())
  retry()
} else if (isTimeout(resp)) {
  rerouteToLowerContextModel()
}
```

leo (SDK): I'll add the exact snippet for Node + Python highlighting `retry-after` header reading for fetch/requests and our SDK `RetryPolicy` helper.

docs-bot: link-checker found two broken links in the branch: /docs/err-ref/rate-limits and /sdk/v0.9/retries. Fix before merge.

maya (Docs): thanks — I'll update links to /docs/error-reference/rate-limits and point old v0.9 snippets to migration guide. also adding a short test checklist for QA: 1) simulate 429 with Retry-After 2) simulate token-timeout + fallback 3) confirm telemetry tag.

sam (Eng): Perf question — when rerouting to smaller model, should we automatically trim to last N tokens or use semantic summarization? which do we recommend?

anita (PM): recommend deterministic trim to last 1024 tokens for now, note experiments with summarization as enhancement.

maya (Docs): plan: I'll push PR, tag @leo for SDK snippets, @sam for logic review, @anita for product acceptance. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 (branch: rate-throttle-playbook)

leo (SDK): ack, I'll drop Node + Python snippets and a tiny migration note. ETA EOD.

sam (Eng): I'll add the operational runbook lines and example metrics query. quick check: do we mention fallbacks to different regions? maybe keep for later.

maya (Docs): skipping region fallbacks for this round. If infra wants it we add in follow-up. merging checklist done ✅

anita (PM): awesome. :tada:

maya (Docs): ping me if blocked; otherwise expect merge tomorrow AM.
